grading: Correct only if every requested material fact resolved, no contradiction or unsupported guess. Partial for missing/unresolved parts, incorrect for any material contradiction. Judge content rather than support label.

answers.answer: Use 8 Fear markers, 9 shuffled Fear cards divided 3/3/3 by Terror II and III dividers; Invader deck is 3 Stage I above 4 Stage II above 5 Stage III, randomized within each stage with one unused card per stage removed unseen. Initial Blight is 5 with a Healthy Island card (2 per player +1), or 11 without (5 per player +1). Setup Explore the top card normally and leave it face-up in Build; Ravage is initially empty.

Yes; resolve Growth actions in chosen order, so the first placement can extend the second. Each placement takes the leftmost remaining Presence from either chosen track. Use only the highest uncovered Energy number and highest uncovered Card Plays number, not their sum.

Reposition one of its island Presence instead of taking a track disk. First choose a legal destination measured from existing island Presence, including the disk about to be repositioned, then take any of its island disks. Destroyed Presence is unavailable unless explicitly allowed.

Play and pay for all cards in the Spirit Phase, gaining their Elements immediately, including Slow cards. Later Fast-phase Energy cannot pay these earlier costs. Unspent Energy carries over; unused Card Plays do not.

A Fast Power must be used during Fast or foregone; it cannot wait until Slow. Players choose Power order but finish one before another. Choose the Slow target when using the Power in Slow, using the then-current legal range and target, not irrevocably at card play.

Invaders do 3 Damage simultaneously to land and Dahan, adding one Blight, killing one Dahan and damaging the other by 1. The surviving Dahan still deals 2 Damage, destroying the Town and generating 1 Fear. Dahan do not absorb/prevent land damage; partial Dahan damage clears at Time Passes.
Surviving Dahan counterattack for 2 each even if Defend reduces Invader damage to zero. If the Ravage is skipped entirely, no counterattack. Presence does not counterattack.
Only Explorers or equal Town/City numbers: add one Town. More Towns than Cities: add one City. No Invaders: no Build. These are new pieces from supply; no Town is removed/upgraded.

Explore matching lands that contain a Town/City or are adjacent to a Town/City/Ocean. Add exactly one Explorer from supply regardless of sources or existing pieces. Explorers are not sources. Needing to draw when the deck is empty loses; drawing the last existing card alone does not.
Discard old Ravage, move Build to Ravage and just-explored card to Build. Stage III acts in both terrain types subject to usual action restrictions. Ignore Stage II flags without an Adversary.

Move the eighth marker to earn the top Fear card face-down, reset all 8 to the pool and put the remaining 2 generated Fear toward the next card. Terror II applies as soon as exposed (subject to outcome check at action-tree end). Keep card hidden until Fear step, resolving in earned order at the then-current Terror level only.

Put the new card at the bottom of the resolving stack and resolve it in this same Fear step. Subsequent cards use the new Terror Level only. Each player resolves their instructions completely, restricted only by the card; own Presence/range is not required. Generic Presence/Sacred Site conditions may use any Spirit’s unless specifically individualized.

Destroy one Presence each of A and B, putting destroyed disks beside the island, not on tracks. Add the original Blight and cascade one additional Blight to one adjacent land, not all. If that land already has Blight it too loses one Presence per Spirit there and cascades again. Existing amount of Blight does not multiply the one cascade.

Setup island Blight comes from the box, not initial pool, and does not cascade or destroy Presence. Play Blight comes from card/board pool. When Healthy empties flip and follow the Blighted instructions, adding the printed new per-player pool from box; do not apply setup +1 again. Removed island Blight returns to currently face-up card/board pool; a Blighted card never flips back.

Elements are checked, not spent, so may meet any number of Powers/thresholds. An innate is normally one use, regardless of surplus Elements. Use all met levels top to bottom on one target, with Instead replacing previous effects. May pretend to have fewer Elements for the entire Power, not cherry-pick levels.

May use it; perform instructions in order, skipping impossible parts and doing the rest. Cannot skip possible mandatory instructions at will (apart from permitted choices, up-to, or selecting fewer Elements consistently). May forego the whole Power; no Energy refund, and played-card Elements remain while in play.

Choose Minor or Major, draw 4 from that deck, reshuffling its discard if needed; keep one in hand, discard the other three to its deck discard. Gaining a Major requires Forgetting any one owned card (hand, personal discard, in play, even new Major); forgotten Minor/Major goes to its deck discard, Unique under panel. Forgetting in-play immediately loses Elements and unused use; previously resolved effects persist for their normal duration.

Damage normally means to Invaders only, distributed as chosen in target land; can combine within turn, immediately destroying pieces at Damage >= Health. Destroying Town/City produces 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear. Remove/Replace generate none automatically; Replace retains prior Damage and may cause destruction if Damage meets new Health (then destruction Fear applies). Surviving Damage clears at Time Passes. Dahan are harmed by Powers only if explicitly stated.

Range boost changes reaching the target, not Gather/Push adjacency. Gather from adjacent land(s) into target; Push from target to adjacent land(s), distributing among them freely. No ordinary Ocean/off-board Push, as Ocean is not a land (specific Spirit exceptions override). Up to may be zero.

Terror I: no Invaders; II: no Towns/Cities; III: no Cities; earning final Fear card reveals Victory and wins without resolving it. Defeat: exhausted Blight pool as instructed (or board pool empty), any Spirit without island Presence, or need to draw Invader card from empty deck. Complete current action plus triggered actions before outcome check; single-land Ravage can yield sacrifice victory if both win/loss met. Do not continue to other land Ravages before that check.

Adjacency is sharing a border or corner, including across boards. Coastal means touching printed Ocean, not cliff edges; other lands are Inland. Ocean is not normally a land/in play. A land is not adjacent to itself but is Range 0 of itself and hence within Range 1.

Take its four Unique cards as starting hand, follow back-panel setup on a different starting board per Spirit, choose among equally legal options, and allow multiple instructions to place in the same land. Later Presence and Powers may use any board.
No, ordinarily one Spirit needs at least two own disks. Four of that Spirit’s disks in one land still make only one site. Your land is a land containing your Presence.

May select despite an impossible non-cost instruction, doing all possible instructions in any order and skipping impossible parts. Explicit cost must be paid in full. May wait for another Spirit’s Growth result; each obeys own Growth/Energy/play order and all finish Spirit Phase before any Fast resolution.

Ordinary Reclaim returns all personal-discard cards to hand, not currently played or forgotten cards. Reclaim One returns one personal-discard card at any time during Spirit Phase once per phase, including the turn it is uncovered.

Track Element is usable immediately whenever revealed and continuously while uncovered. Any may be selected at any time in the turn but cannot change once chosen until next turn. Forgetting an in-play card immediately removes its Elements.

Yes, check Elements at the later threshold. Lost Elements can prevent later thresholds. Completed effects cannot be revised retroactively; Speed/Range/targeting modifications must be checked when selecting/using those attributes, and or-branch choice precedes branch resolution.

Range 0 ordinarily means a land containing your Presence. A boost only extends numeric Range; it does not waive Sacred Site/source, terrain/contents target restrictions or the requirement that a land be one of yours.

May target and use a legal Power even if nothing actually changes, provided it has an instruction with potential to affect game state and attempts its text. Foregoing the text is not using/targeting it. Merely modifying its own Speed/Range does not qualify.

Added Town remains as a board change. Build skip expires at Time Passes. Played cards go to personal discard, all surviving Invader/Dahan Damage clears, card Elements and temporary effects clear, reminder markers removed. Track Elements remain while uncovered.
Damaged pieces deal normal Damage. Defend adds to 3, reducing 4 to 1 separately to land and Dahan, so no Blight and one Dahan takes 1 Damage if present.

Replacement itself causes no Fear. Retained 1 Damage meets Explorer Health 1, so it is destroyed, giving no Fear for an Explorer. More generally, a piece is destroyed immediately once existing Damage meets its reduced/new Health, even without new Damage.

No automatic Dahan attack except Ravage counterattack or explicit Power instruction. Unqualified Power Damage is to Invaders; Dahan require explicit harmful instructions. Dahan and Invaders are unlimited; use substitutes when pieces run out.

No; all ordinary effects remain in one target land, except explicit instructions such as Push destinations. Slash means either/both types within a combined limit: up to three pieces total, not three of each.
Must move three if possible, otherwise as many as possible (two). Unrestricted Move can choose the current land and counts as movement; Gather/Push cannot because they require an adjacent land.

Move measures from that disk’s present land and moves up to the arrow’s distance. Add/reposition first picks a legal destination measured from any existing Presence, then may take any own island disk, even one far from that destination. It remains adding, not a Move instruction.

A Growth-gained card enters hand and may be played in the later play/pay step. A Fast-gained card merely enters hand unless explicitly permitted to play it; even explicit play does not immediately resolve unless stated. No hand-size limit; hands can be shown.

Yes, effect-granted plays are additional to the normal Spirit-phase track limit. Follow payment instructions, gain Elements immediately, and use effects in its speed phase when no other action is resolving, unless explicitly instructed otherwise.

Gifting/transferring is not Gain and requires no Forget. Each Major gained needs its own separate Forget, unless explicitly exempted, so one card cannot cover both. A forgotten Unique is under panel and cannot be retrieved by ordinary Reclaim/gain.

Choose eligible Power Card when actually repeating, not necessarily at grant time. Slow cards can be repeated in Slow; these two effects specify cards and cannot repeat Innates. Printed card Elements are not granted again; explicit Elements in the repeated text are granted again.
Range/speed modifications carry over, so Repeat retains extended Range and Fast speed. Thresholds otherwise check current Elements; losing them may mean a previously met threshold no longer applies.

Repeat instructions on a repeated Power are ignored, so repeating Powerstorm grants no Repeat permissions; its non-Repeat Energy gain still happens. Its threshold allows up to three different Power Cards, not the same one three times.

Explicit Repeat location overrides original Range/target restrictions, so the adjacent land can be used despite them. Original land is not adjacent to itself and cannot be selected under this instruction.

Entering existing Blight does not destroy Presence. Each new Blight addition, including cascade revisits, destroys one Presence per Spirit present and can cascade onward again. Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the single outgoing cascade.

Immediately follow empty-pool instructions, flip/refill from box as directed, and continue unfinished additions/cascades; no setup +1 is added on flip. Removing Blight only returns it to active pool; does not restore destroyed Presence or flip back to Healthy.

Cascade remains part of original single-land Ravage action tree, not a separate outcome-check boundary. Players choose land order and may win at the end of one complete Ravage tree before another land Ravages and could cause loss.

Determine matching eligible lands before resolving the card: initially empty land does not gain a Ravage from this card. In a land already queued to Ravage, new Invaders participate when it resolves. Players may choose any order across both terrains.

All Coastal lands across boards; later Build/Ravage likewise in Coastal lands. Normal restrictions remain: Build/Ravage only eligible lands with Invaders, Explore requires sources (Ocean provides coast access).
No. Skipping actions in source land does not remove its Town/City or prevent neighboring Explore checking that source; the Explore action happens in the destination land.

Yes: just-Explored card is now in Build for next turn, so removing that Explorer before then can prevent its Build. It did not Build during that Explore. Fear cards earned in Slow wait until next Invader Phase’s Fear step.

Different choices only when the card requires them; a piece may move multiple times across successive player choices if legal. Generic Presence/site conditions accept any Spirit’s; explicitly individual own-site counts use each Spirit’s sites separately.
May remove both Cities; Invader includes all three types and no Explorer-first rule applies. Health allowance uses current Health modifiers but marked Damage does not reduce Health.
Yes with at least one Dahan and zero buildings. Zero versus zero is not outnumbering.

Single Spirit may target itself with Another Spirit, but cannot get bonuses conditional on actually targeting another. One human playing two Spirits fills two player roles, scales by two and does not get the single-Spirit targeting exception.
Power user chooses Power decisions. Otherwise seek consensus; if impossible, land decisions belong to Spirit starting on that board, and non-land decisions to game owner/organizer.

Progression is optional teaching aid. Take next listed card into hand instead of draw-four/keep-one; gaining a Major still requires Forgetting. No-card initial pool is 5 per Spirit +1 total and emptying it loses, without flip or ongoing Blighted effect.

Yes, each player chooses a different land and may Gather up to two (including zero). Then II deals one total Damage if Dahan present; III deals total Damage equal to Dahan present, not that amount to each Invader.
The Coastal City Build is entirely skipped; no Town substitute. The Town Build proceeds normally. Trade Suffers III only downgrades in Coastal lands, including when choosing a City.

Single-land Power normally fixes its Defend from contents at use. Island-wide Dahan on their Guard checks current Dahan when damage occurs. Encompassing Ward follows current Presence of target Spirit, so lands gaining/losing that Presence gain/lose its Defend.
Always gain the two Fear; or only separates City/Town replacement clauses. Veil deals one Damage each to the two different Invaders and wastes the third; cannot concentrate it.
Song of Sanctity is Slow. Dissolve line three Pushes all Explorers from target land. Its Invader-on-Invader Damage is simultaneous, so pieces can destroy each other.

Poisoned Land counts its own earlier added Blight. Tsunami threshold generates extra Fear for each other affected Coastal land. Unqualified +4 Damage is four total Damage when that threshold resolves, not four per earlier piece.

Zero Move grants no Defend because there is no moved-to land. Moving Dahan to their own land counts as Move when not otherwise restricted. Blazing Renewal cannot deal threshold Damage without restoring destroyed Presence; that land is the placement land.

Defend 6 stays in original land and Defend 2 reaches each destination (2 per Dahan Pushed by this Power), independent of other Dahan there. Later unrelated movement does not carry Defend. Additional Defend boosts in original land stay there.
It protects from Damage/Destroy, not Remove/Replace. Protected land remains a legal Blight/cascade choice; protection changes what happens, not whether it may be selected.

May treat combined Presence as a site only while targeting Powers. Not a real site for Fear or other effects, and no shared Presence for Power text/your-land effects. River’s Wetland special site rule remains River’s own, not the other Spirit’s.

It can gain two Power Cards and with threshold gain 6 Energy; separate Major gains each need Forgetting. Defined special effects such as Drown remain usable from the gifted card and go to Ocean’s panel as defined; skip instructions requiring an unavailable personal track.
Yes to both land choices: target Spirit chooses one of its lands and does as much as possible there. Tidal Boon’s clause applies only to its own Push, not later unrelated Pushes.
Mantle’s Spirit-targeting Fear has no specific land unless text names one, so does not supply a land for Dread Apparitions. Harbingers’ Fear is generated in its target land.

Use during Fast; one Power per current Air Element, including Innates. Recheck current allowance each use; prior uses still count, so gaining/loss changes remaining uses rather than resetting uses or locking a prior peak.
No imaginary second disk; count actual disks. For an effect moving/affecting a Sacred Site, River may choose one or two actual Presence as applicable/available.

Need an actual Sacred Site origin and all other nonnumeric source/target restrictions. Pay one Energy when using the Power, not card play. Numeric range-ignore modification carries to Repeat without another surcharge; explicit Repeat location overrides normal targeting.

No. Choosing fewer Elements applies consistently to whole Power; if Elements meet the second and thereby first, perform first-level Gather if possible before destroying. Cannot choose individual threshold instructions to omit.

Choke is optional. Steady Regeneration checks Healthy/Blighted state of Blight Card, not destination land’s Blight. May order Growth instructions so the gained Power informs the mandatory placement; explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence.
Up to one Presence per moved Dahan, so two, with them. Generic Move qualifies as well as Gather/Push. Presence may accompany them into a legally targeted Ocean via the Power/Ocean-rule interaction.

Yes; for each Dahan destroyed by that Ravage, destroy one of Thunderspeaker’s Presence within Range 1 after the entire single-land Ravage, including any Blight/cascades/Presence loss and counterattack. Blight is not a prerequisite.

Yes, any of Ocean’s Presence on board activates Ocean In Play; no Ocean disk required. Ocean is Coastal Wetland for Powers and Blight, not normal Fear/Invader actions. Humans moved there are Drowned after originating movement action.

Cascade into that Ocean is legal. Normal Growth cannot treat it as Coastal Wetland to add there, but may measure from existing Presence in Ocean. Indomitable Claim explicitly ignores land-type restrictions and can place Ocean Presence Inland; ordinary adding Powers do not bypass its restriction.

Fear earned immediately on destruction: 1 for Town and 2 for City. Drowned Invaders go on Ocean panel for later trade. Trade X printed Health for 1 Energy, X=Spirits, so in two-Spirit game City gives 1 Energy plus 1 Health change. Ignore Health modifiers; Dahan drown with no Energy benefit.

Only explicit Drown or Ocean’s triggered destruction of moved-in humans is Drowning, not thematic ordinary destruction. Ocean In Play persists through current action tree, then ends. Nonhuman pieces remain physically but out of play until Ocean returns. Humans must be in legal lands: failed Drown attempts Push to non-Ocean land during that action; any still-illegal humans clean up to nearest legal land after all triggers.

Put it in nearest legal land, using judgment/physical distance for ambiguity. Cleanup is none of move/destroy/remove/action and triggers nothing; if no legal land exists, return it to supply still as cleanup. Do before outcome check after tree.

Separate Powers do not combine hypothetical Damage and each does nothing to undamaged City. Single Power’s instructions combine to would-destroy City and earn 5 Fear, leaving City actually unchanged. Repeat is separate action and can pretend-destroy same piece again if its own Damage suffices; cannot combine its hypothetical Damage with original.
Each hypothetical destruction earns 5 Fear, 10 total. City survives with its original 2 real Damage; Bringer neither marks new Damage nor clears real Damage. Repeat can affect same City again.
Would-destroy Explorer: zero Fear and Push; Town: 2 Fear and Push; City: 5 Fear, no Push. No real destruction, so no Mists actual-destruction bonus or Vengeance trigger from pretend deaths.

Its Power’s explicit Damage/Destroy remains hypothetical even if wording names another actor. Fear Cards and Ravage counterattacks are separate and deal real Damage. Bringer can Remove/Replace and add real Blight; added Blight destroys Presence normally.

Yes, its Power need not explicitly Damage/Destroy; core Health rules destroy when retained Damage meets new Health. Ocean’s separate rule Drowns Pushed Town, producing 1 actual Fear in addition to Bringer’s 2, total 3.
Yes, its first effect can flip any Fear Card in those locations.

This Power is Call on Midnight’s Dreams. Forgetting that card for ordinary Major requirement also satisfies conditional, so no second Forget. Forgotten original leaves play and cannot later be Repeated via ordinary Powerstorm once-this-turn permission.

Trigger after the entire Power/action, using total qualifying pieces destroyed, not after each instruction. Cannot trigger itself even indirectly. Two separately set-up effects can trigger each other, but an effect cannot recur within its own chain, so no infinite loop.
No. Directly gained flexible Elements must be chosen immediately when gained; passive track Any can wait until later in turn, then is fixed for that turn.
It is destroyed in the destination. There is no in-between location; it has the starting bonus until arriving, then new Health immediately applies.
Single action totals its allowance and may remove any set at or below it, not mandatory batches. Separate each-player removals are separate actions and their allowances cannot be combined.
One action per land with Towns/Cities. II destroys one Explorer per Town plus two per City. III destroys all Explorers then one Town per City. Do not split Town/City clauses into independent actions.

Immediately flip, carry the remaining old Blight into the new pool and add printed new pool without setup bonus. Fully resolve immediate flipped-card effects as nested actions before returning to add the two Blight.
Ordinary Repeat uses most recently assigned speed, so now Slow. Explicit immediate Repeat timing happens immediately after original use regardless of phase.
Yes, Powers/Special Rules can measure through active Ocean as land. Coastal remains adjacency to printed Ocean; cliff/outside edges do not become Coastal merely as outside edges.

No, healthy Towns/Cities survive one Damage unless prior Damage or further effects/thresholds finish them. Boosted Damage belongs to original Power, so actual buildings it destroys with boosts count for its destruction-based Fear.
No; it changes timing instead of granting an extra attack. Each Dahan still deals Ravage Damage only once.

Only each instructions: one action per each (e.g., per player). Mixed global and each instructions: one overall action with nested per-each actions. Complete appropriate action tree before checking outcomes; do not combine independent each-player actions into one.

It cannot remain in the Ocean between action trees. Clean it up to the nearest legal land before the outcome check. Cleanup is not a Move, Remove, Destroy or action and triggers no movement effects. If no legal land exists, return it to supply as cleanup.
No. Land and Dahan damage are simultaneous, so the existing Sacred Site’s Defend protects both in that Ravage. Loss of site from resulting Blight does not retroactively remove that protection.

No ordinary sharing of individual Energy or Card Plays; Energy stays with its Spirit and can carry over, unused Card Plays expire. Explicit Power grants follow their instructions and can grant Energy or extra plays, but are not free sharing of the ordinary limits/resources.

Resolve Blighted Island instructions first, then earned Fear, Ravage, Build, Explore and advance Invader cards. Finish the Blighted effect action tree and check outcomes before Fear; if a Spirit still has no island Presence and no win condition is met then, lose without resolving the later Fear card. Cannot reorder to avert loss.

Those explicit Damage/Destroy instructions do nothing to Dahan because Bringer's Powers cannot destroy anything other than its own Presence. Skip the impossible harmful instruction and resolve the other legal effects normally; do not skip the whole Power merely because of it.
source_refs: CORE p.17 do as much as possible

answers.answer: No. Shadows' conditional targeting ability changes only the numeric Range used to choose the land target, leaving internal Range arrows unchanged. General Power Range bonuses can affect printed Range values in a Power's targeting box and effect text, subject to all restrictions, but do not increase a Range bonus itself and do not apply to another Spirit's Powers merely because they target the boosted Spirit. Neither waives other source/target restrictions.
Do not stack the same internal Range boost a second time: the Repeat retains the original +1, not +2. It retains that Range modification even if the threshold is no longer met when repeating.

Two cards played: a Repeat does not play another Power Card and adds no card to that count. It nevertheless counts as a new Power use. It consumes no additional ordinary Card Play; any payment required by a Repeat permission is separate.

No. An unspecified instruction affecting Presence refers to that Spirit's Presence on the island, not track disks. Destroy an island disk and put it beside the island, not on the Spirit panel; no track benefit is uncovered by that loss.
Choose a random Blight Card and start Healthy Island side face-up, without looking at its reverse. Players cannot inspect backs and choose their preferred outcome.
source_refs: CORE p.6 Invader Board setup step 5

answers.answer: It may use the eligible Innate at its proper speed: unless explicitly specified otherwise it costs no Energy and no Card Play and is not a card played from hand. Innates are automatically available every turn when their requirements are met. Ordinary once-per-turn and targeting rules still apply.
source_refs: CORE p.14 Spirit panel item 9; p.16 Powers

answers.answer: No to both. Ordinary Powers have one use per turn; paying again grants no second use. Making Slow Fast changes that use's timing, not its number: use it in Fast only, with no separate Slow-phase use. Additional uses require an explicit effect such as Repeat.
source_refs: CORE p.17 One Land! One Turn! One Use! bullet 3

answers.answer: Randomly choose one balanced Island Board per Spirit and join them into the island. Populate every land according to its printed Invader, Dahan and Blight icons, taking setup Blight from the box rather than depleting the pool; setup Blight does not cascade or destroy Presence. Shuffle Minor and Major decks separately, each with its own shared discard space, and put Energy, Invaders and Dahan in shared supplies accessible to players.
source_refs: CORE p.6 Island and Supply; pp.13,15

answers.answer: Ocean In Play Pushes the surviving Dahan to a non-Ocean land as part of its own triggered action. This is an actual Push, capable of triggering applicable movement effects; it is not the later non-action cleanup operation. Cleanup only handles a piece still illegally placed after the action tree. No expansion effect or piece is needed for this branch: the FAQ expressly supplies Infinite Vitality threshold on the Ocean as a core-game case.

It need not keep its original target. The Spirit may choose any valid target by the ordinary Range and Target rules, either the original land or a different legal land. Only a Repeat that specifies its destination replaces those normal restrictions with the specified-location instruction.

The Invaders deal 3 Damage to land, adding one Blight; Concealing Shadows protects only Dahan and does not reduce land Damage. The Dahan take zero Damage and both survive healthy, then counterattack for 4 total Damage. They may destroy the Town (2 Health) and Explorer (1), with excess Damage unused, generating 1 Fear from the Town during this Ravage. The Power’s earlier printed Fear is separate from the requested Ravage-generated Fear.

The simultaneous addition destroys one Presence from each Spirit, even though two Blight tokens are added. Two separate additions destroy one Presence per Spirit on each addition, hence two per Spirit if available. Cascades elsewhere are outside the requested count.

Concealing Shadows does not prevent them: its protection is only against Damage from Ravaging Invaders, while Poisoned Land explicitly Destroys Dahan. Infinite Vitality's threshold makes those Dahan ignore Damage and Destruction effects, so it prevents that destruction.
source_refs: Primary original card faces: Concealing Shadows, Poisoned Land, Infinite Vitality in card-scope-source/

answers.answer: Direct Spirit Power Damage is not reduced by Defend, so those Dahan take 2 Damage in the Defend-only case. Concealing Shadows also does not prevent it because it only protects from Ravaging Invaders. Infinite Vitality’s threshold does prevent that Damage. In the separate Invader Ravage case, Defend 3 reduces 2 to zero for both land and Dahan, not negative Damage.

The grant stays +2; Range boosts do not increase another Range boost. Reaching Grasp’s Power-only bonus applies to B’s Powers, including Innates and Power Cards, subject to the normal Range-arrow restrictions. It does not extend ordinary Growth, which is not a Power; Power Cards also resolve after normal Growth.
source_refs: Primary original Reaching Grasp face: card-scope-source/reaching_grasp.jpg

answers.answer: For a land-targeting Power, measure the internal arrow from the target land unless otherwise specified. For a Spirit-targeting Power, normally measure from the Presence of the Spirit following the instruction, B here, unless the text says otherwise. Apply the bonuses of the Power user A, not B: the stated Range 1 becomes Range 3 from B’s Presence. Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from the Power user A’s Presence, even when B adds Presence; its explicit origin overrides the default.

Its printed Elements remain while the card is in play and can support Innates even though its text was not used. The paid Energy is not refunded. Foregoing the text does not remove/discard the card immediately; it stays in play and is normally discarded during Time Passes, when its Elements go away.
source_refs: CORE p.17 General Principle You Can Skip Using A Power’s Effect; pp.8,10,16

answers.answer: Defend is not expended: it reduces each Ravage by 3 for the entire turn. Each deals 1 Damage to land and 1 to Dahan. Land Damage below 2 is ignored per occurrence, so the two 1-Damage land results never combine into Blight. The Dahan’s first 1 Damage persists until Time Passes; the second 1 reaches its 2 Health and destroys it before a second counterattack.
